title: Talking About Ideas --- Hedging From Doubt, and From Inference
label: ch:ideas
canDo: I can put an idea forward in Spanish while marking how sure I am of it, and tell an admission of ignorance from a claimed inference.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C271-supongo-que: state one idea three ways -- bare, hedged with quizas, and hedged with supongo que -- and say what each does to your commitment.
